title: The Stochastic TR-BDF2 Scheme of Order 2
summary: Our main objective in this paper is to develop a second-order stochastic numerical method which generalizes the well-known deterministic TR-BDF2 scheme. Since most stochastic techniques used for approximating the solution of a stochastic differential equation may have lower order compared to the deterministic case, we have elaborated a scheme which not only preserves the second-order accuracy of the original scheme in the stochastic framework, but also its $A$-stability.
